about_the_game:
Welcome to Super Loco World! As the freshly-minted transport tycoon around these parts, you’ll need to build up a rail network, manage train traffic, and keep the goods flowing to meet the growing demands of an ever-evolving world!

Build and automate intricate railroads effortlessly and deliver goods to meet the demands of a dynamic world! Make clever use of signals and signposts to avoid traffic jams, and watch your villages blossom into bustling towns in this cozy take on the train tycoon genre.

In this demo version of Super Loco World you will be able to access all functionalities of the game such as:

- track construction
- train controls, track controls
- goods delivery
- island creation
- rail signals automatization
- trains refuelling

Ease of Rail Building 🚧

Forget about the fiddly side of crafting complex railroad systems in other train tycoon games. Instead, use your cursor like a painter’s brush and let the game automatically figure out T-junctions, bridges, or even curved rails!

Realistic train behaviour 🚂

Build your depot to create new trains, and bring them back whenever you want to add or remove carriages. Just watch out for traffic jams along the way, as these trains need a clear track - and a turnaround loop for moving back and forth between stations! 

Embrace automation🚦

Your trains need more than just a route from you! Control their speeds carefully, manage rail junctions, and eventually automate the process using some very handy rail signals, including: 

  • Signposts to direct trains carrying different goods in different directions. 

  • Logic-based stop signs to help you manage congested areas. 

  • Traffic lights to control the flow of trains into stations. 

A dynamic economy 📉

Every game world and its resources are randomly generated, giving you a fresh experience with every new run. Once a village’s basic needs have been met, you’ll need to expand your rail network to meet their increasing demands, all while balancing the costs of keeping your fleet fuelled!  

Super Loco World encourages creativity at every turn, and you’ll never be penalized for rebuilding railroads or infrastructure.
